title: Identify the vacuum breaker by where air can enter
description: Separate hose-bib, atmospheric, and pressure vacuum breakers before treating a drip or discharge as a failure.
answer: Vacuum breakers stop backsiphonage by admitting air. A hose faucet attachment, an atmospheric breaker, and a testable pressure vacuum breaker are different products with different limits.
urgency: Do not cap an air inlet or relief opening to stop a leak. That opening is part of the safety function.
diagramAlt: Simplified pressure vacuum breaker with raised bonnet and air inlet
identifiers: A PVB normally sits above downstream irrigation piping with shutoffs and test cocks.
An AVB is simpler and must not be treated like a continuously pressurized testable assembly.
A hose-bib breaker threads directly onto an outdoor faucet and is much smaller.

choices.label: It leaks only during start or shutdown
choices.detail: Timing can separate brief drain-down from an ongoing fault.

choices.label: It leaks continuously
choices.detail: Move to the safety-first leak path; do not block the vent.

choices.label: I need annual testing information
choices.detail: First confirm whether the installed model is testable, then check the utility.

steps.title: Find the air inlet
steps.body: Look for a bonnet, poppet, or vent designed to admit air.

steps.title: Check the installation height
steps.body: PVBs are commonly elevated; hose-bib devices are attached directly to a faucet.

steps.title: Record the model
steps.body: The manufacturer model tells you whether the unit is testable and which service information applies.

safeChecks: Turn off the downstream irrigation zone and observe whether discharge stops.
Look for freeze cracks without disassembly.
Check whether debris is visible around an exposed vent.
stopConditions: A device serving a commercial or fire-related system
notThisDevice: An RPZ has a relief zone beneath a larger inline body.
A pressure regulator changes pressure but does not provide the same cross-connection protection.
A sewer backwater valve is installed in drainage piping.
evidenceNote: The shape is a screening clue, not a certification. Use the model label and the local utility rule for the final decision.
